ctx: 同事早上在電梯遇到你
line: Good morning! How are you today?
a: Not bad, thanks. You?
d: Good night, see you.
Yes, I'm going up.
It's on the fifth floor.
ex: 回應寒暄後反問對方最自然;其他是道晚安、答樓層,答非所問。

line: Are you ready to order?
a: Could we have a few more minutes, please?
d: Could we get the check now, please?
Yes, it was delicious, thank you.
Thanks, I'll take a table by the window.
ex: 還沒決定就禮貌請對方多給幾分鐘;要帳單、評價餐點是用餐後才說的。

line: For here or to go?
a: To go, please.
d: Go ahead, please.
A large one, please.
I'm ready to go now.
ex: For here or to go 問內用或外帶,答 To go 即外帶;其他誤解 go 或答尺寸。

line: Do you have a reservation?
a: Yes, under the name Chen.
d: Yes, may I have your name, please?
Yes, I have a few doubts about it.
No, I'm just checking out today.
ex: under the name ___ 是「用某某名字訂的」;問名字是櫃檯的話,reservation 不是疑慮。

line: Do you have any liquids in your bag?
a: Just a small bottle of lotion.
d: No thanks, I'm not thirsty right now.
Yes, I'd like a bottle of water.
Yes, it's my only carry-on.
ex: liquids 指液體物品,不是問你渴不渴;直接說明帶了什麼。

line: Excuse me, is there a pharmacy near here?
a: Yes, there's one just around the corner.
d: No, I don't need any medicine, thanks.
Yes, it opens at nine every morning.
Yes, I've lived near here for about five years.
ex: there's one around the corner = 轉角就有;其他答營業時間、誤會成推銷或談自己。

line: Can I help you?
a: No thanks, I'm just looking.
d: Sure, what can I help you with?
No thanks, I've already eaten.
Sorry, I don't work here.
ex: I'm just looking 是「隨便看看」;其他把角色弄反或誤會成請吃東西。

line: Thanks for the coffee!
a: You're welcome.
d: Same to you.
No, I'm good, thanks.
Yes, it's very good.
ex: 回應道謝用 You're welcome;Same to you 是回祝福,其他像在婉拒或評咖啡。

line: Sorry I'm late.
a: That's OK. We just started.
d: Sorry, I'll be there soon.
Sure, we'll start at nine.
Thanks for the reminder.
ex: 簡單接受道歉並說明狀況;其他像遲到者說的話或答非所問。

line: Hello, may I speak to Kevin?
a: Sure, just a moment, please.
d: Hi Kevin, how are you?
Yes, I'm calling for Kevin.
Sure, I'll speak up a bit.
ex: 請對方稍等再轉接;其他把來電者當 Kevin、像打電話的人,或誤解 speak。

line: Nice to meet you.
a: Nice to meet you, too.
d: Nice to see you again, too.
It was nice meeting you.
Yes, I'm doing well.
ex: 初見面回 Nice to meet you, too;see you again 是重逢,meeting 版是道別用。

line: That'll be 350 dollars.
a: Can I pay by card?
d: Can I have the bill?
How much is it?
Keep the change.
ex: 店員已報價,問付款方式最自然;問價錢、要帳單重複,還沒付錢不能說不用找。

line: Do you want to get lunch together?
a: Sure, where do you want to go?
d: Sure, I'll have the chicken.
Yes, I'm free next weekend.
Sure, how was your lunch?
ex: 答應並問去哪裡;點餐是在餐廳說的,問午餐如何是吃完後的事。

line: Where to?
a: Taipei Main Station, please.
d: I'd like a ticket to Taipei, please.
Taipei Main Station is that way.
It's my first time in Taipei, actually.
ex: Where to? 是司機問目的地,直接說地點加 please。

line: How many nights will you be staying?
a: Three nights.
d: Three of us.
At three.
Three nights ago.
ex: 問住幾晚直接答數量;three of us 答人數,at three 答時間,ago 是過去。

line: Have a nice weekend!
a: Thanks, you too!
d: Thanks, it was great!
See you on Saturday!
I'm glad you liked it!
ex: You too 回祝對方;週末還沒開始不能說 it was great,週六也不會見面。

ctx: 用餐快結束,服務生來問
line: How was everything?
a: It was delicious, thank you.
d: It looks delicious, thank you.
Everything, please. We're very hungry.
Just the soup, thank you.
ex: 用餐結束問餐點如何,用過去式評價;looks delicious 是上菜時說的。

line: What seems to be the problem?
a: I've had a sore throat since Monday.
d: I'd like to make an appointment for Monday.
I'm fine, thanks. How about you?
My insurance card is in my wallet.
ex: have had ... since 描述持續到現在的症狀。

ctx: 你坐在咖啡店,有人指著你旁邊空位
line: Is this seat taken?
a: No, go ahead.
d: No, thanks.
After you.
Yes, please.
ex: 問「有人坐嗎」,沒人坐答 No, go ahead;No, thanks 是婉拒提議。

line: Can you help me carry this box?
a: Sure, no problem.
d: Thanks, I can manage.
Sure, it's on the table.
Thanks, I'll take it.
ex: 爽快答應;I can manage 是婉拒別人幫忙,這裡是你被請求。

line: Do you need a bag?
a: No, I'm fine, thanks.
d: Yes, I'm doing well.
Sure, here you go.
No, it's not mine.
ex: I'm fine 在這裡是「不用了」;不是問你好不好,也不是問袋子是誰的。

line: What do you usually do on weekends?
a: I usually go hiking or watch movies.
d: I went hiking with my family last weekend.
I usually work from nine to six on weekdays.
I'm free this Saturday, actually.
ex: 問平常習慣用現在簡單式;上週末、這週六、平日行程都答錯問題。

line: Window or aisle?
a: Aisle, please.
d: Yes, please.
To Tokyo.
One bag, please.
ex: 選擇題問句不能答 Yes,要選一個;其他答目的地、行李數。

ctx: 幫同事接電話,對方說要找的人不在
line: Oh, he's not in? Can I leave a message?
a: Of course. Go ahead.
d: OK, I'll call back.
Yes, he left early.
Sure, see you then.
ex: 對方要留言,請他說即可;其他像來電者的話或沒回應留言請求。

line: How was your weekend?
a: Great, I went to the beach.
d: Great, I'm going hiking.
Good, I'll stay home.
Not yet, maybe Saturday.
ex: 談上週末用過去式 went;其他在講未來計畫,答非所問。

line: Excuse me, what time is it?
a: It's about half past three.
d: It's about three hours from here.
It takes about half an hour.
Yes, I have a watch right here.
ex: half past three = 三點半;其他答距離、所需時間,或只說有手錶。

line: Would you like something to drink?
a: Just water, please.
d: Just looking, thanks.
Just the bill, please.
A table for two.
ex: Just ___, please 簡潔禮貌;其他是逛街、買單、帶位時說的。

line: Can you send me the file?
a: Sure, I'll send it now.
d: Thanks, I got it.
Sure, send it over.
Yes, it's on my desk.
ex: I'll + 動詞表示當下決定要做;收到、請對方寄是對方角色的話。

line: I passed my driving test!
a: Congratulations! That's great news.
d: Thanks! I worked really hard for it.
Good luck! I hope you pass it.
Congratulations! When is the wedding?
ex: 朋友已通過,恭喜即可;Good luck 用於考前,其他是本人或婚禮用語。

line: Here's your key card. Your room is on the fifth floor.
a: Thank you. What time is breakfast?
d: Thanks. What floor is my room on?
Thanks. When do you check in?
Thank you. Here's your key card.
ex: 道謝後問早餐時間;樓層已說過,其他兩句是櫃檯人員的台詞。

line: Would you like to try it on?
a: Yes. Where's the fitting room?
d: Sure, I'll try to finish it today.
Yes, it fits me perfectly, thanks.
Yes, I'd love a taste.
ex: fitting room 是試衣間;還沒試不能說合身,try it on 不是試吃或嘗試。

line: Are you free tomorrow afternoon?
a: Yes, after two o'clock.
d: Yes, it's free of charge.
Yes, I'm free now.
Yes, I was out today.
ex: 回答有空並給時段;free of charge 是免費,問的是明天不是現在。

ctx: 朋友不小心打破你的杯子
line: I'm sorry, I broke your cup.
a: Don't worry about it.
d: Sorry, I'll buy you a new one.
You're welcome, anytime.
Be careful, it's very hot.
ex: Don't worry about it 接受道歉;You're welcome 回謝謝,買新的是打破的人說。

line: Does this bus go to the airport?
a: No, you need the 1819.
d: No, I'm waiting for my friend.
It comes every ten minutes.
Yes, my flight leaves at nine.
ex: 直接回答並告訴對方該搭哪班車。

line: Could you speak more slowly, please?
a: Of course. Sorry about that.
d: Of course. Could you speak up?
Sure, I'll speak louder.
No problem. You're welcome.
ex: 同意放慢並致歉;slowly 是慢不是大聲,對方也不是在道謝。

ctx: 朋友問你生日想要什麼
line: What would you like for your birthday?
a: Nothing special — just dinner together.
d: It's on March twelfth, actually.
I had a great party with my family last year.
I'd like to buy you a gift this year, too.
ex: 回答想要什麼;說生日日期、去年的派對、要送對方禮物都答非所問。

line: We don't have this in a medium, sorry.
a: That's OK. Do you have it in a large?
d: That's OK. I'll take a medium, then.
Oh, sorry. We'll order more soon.
That's OK. Is it medium rare?
ex: in a large 指 L 號;沒 M 號不能買 M,補貨是店員才說的話。

line: Do you mind if I open the window?
a: Not at all. Go ahead.
d: Sure, I'll close it.
Sorry, I didn't mean to.
It's by the door.
ex: Do you mind 問「介意嗎」,同意答 Not at all;關窗、道歉都不對題。

line: Can I see your passport, please?
a: Sure, here you are.
d: Sure, here's my ticket.
Yes, I can see it.
Sure, I'll wait.
ex: 遞東西說 Here you are;要的是護照不是機票,see 是查看。

line: Hi, are we still meeting at 3?
a: Yes, see you in Room B.
d: Yes, it was really useful.
Yes, I'm still in a meeting.
Yes, three of us are coming.
ex: 確認仍照原定並補充地點;3 是時間不是人數,會議還沒開。

line: Can you check this link? It doesn't open for me.
a: Sure, give me a sec.
d: Yes, it opens at 9.
No, it's closed.
Thanks, that works.
ex: give me a sec = 給我一下;這裡 open 指連結打不開,不是店的營業。

line: Running 10 mins late, sorry!
a: No worries, I'll grab a table.
d: No worries, see you at 10.
No worries, it was fun!
Thanks, I'll be there soon.
ex: No worries 表示沒關係並先佔位;10 mins 是十分鐘,不是十點。

line: Table for one?
a: No, two. My friend is coming.
d: No, I'm not ready to order yet.
No, I'll have the chicken, thanks.
Yes, the bill, please.
ex: 直接更正人數並說明朋友稍後到。

line: Is everything OK with your room?
a: Yes, it's great, but the Wi-Fi is a bit slow.
d: Yes, thanks. I'd like to book a table for two tonight.
Yes, it's on the fifth floor, next to the elevator.
Yes, I'd like to check in, please.
ex: 先肯定再委婉提出小問題,很自然。

line: Let's meet at 7.
a: Sounds good. See you then.
d: Sounds good. Nice to meet you.
Sounds good. How was the meeting?
Thanks, it was great.
ex: Sounds good 接受提議;Nice to meet you 是初次見面,其他在談過去的事。

line: Cash or card?
a: Card, please.
d: Yes, please.
To go, please.
A receipt, please.
ex: 二選一問句要選一個,不能答 Yes;其他答外帶、收據。

line: Sorry, could you repeat that?
a: Sure. I said the meeting is moved to Thursday.
d: Sure. Could you speak a little more slowly, please?
Sure. I'll repeat the class next semester, I guess.
Sure. Let me know if you have any more questions.
ex: 重述重點;請人放慢是聽者的話,repeat 不是重修。

line: How do I get to the MRT station?
a: Go straight and turn left at the bank.
d: You can buy a ticket at the machine over there.
I usually get there by scooter every morning.
It's open until midnight, I think.
ex: turn left at ___ 是指路基本句型。

line: Are you hungry?
a: A little. Let's eat something.
d: A little. Let's take a nap.
A bit. Let's turn on the AC.
A little. Can I get some water?
ex: hungry 是餓;想睡、太熱、口渴的回應都對不上。

line: Are you allergic to anything?
a: Yes, I'm allergic to penicillin.
d: Yes, I take vitamins every morning.
Yes, my insurance covers it.
Yes, I had a flu shot in May.
ex: allergic to + 物品回答過敏原;維他命、保險、疫苗都不是過敏。

line: Thanks for your help today.
a: Anytime.
d: Got it.
Me too.
Sorry.
ex: Anytime = 隨時樂意幫忙;回 Got it、Me too、Sorry 都不是接受道謝。

line: Sorry, we're closing in five minutes.
a: Oh, OK. I'll be quick.
d: Oh, OK. Take your time, then.
Oh, OK. I'll stay a bit longer.
Oh, OK. Have a nice holiday!
ex: 表示理解並加快;Take your time 是讓別人慢慢來,方向相反。

line: Would you like some cake?
a: Yes, please. It looks great.
d: Yes, please. It was great.
Yes, I baked it myself.
Sure, help yourself.
ex: 接受並稱讚外觀;還沒吃不能說 was great,help yourself 是主人說的。

ctx: 新同事自我介紹後問你
line: Where are you from?
a: I'm from Hsinchu, in Taiwan.
d: I'm going to Hsinchu next week.
I've been here for three years.
I'm fine, thanks. And you?
ex: I'm from ___ 說明出身地。

line: Is this your first time in Japan?
a: No, it's my third visit.
d: No, I'm here on business.
Yes, for three days.
No, I came by plane.
ex: 問是否第一次來,No + 第幾次最清楚;其他答目的、天數或交通。

line: Hey, how did the presentation go?
a: Pretty well, thanks. They liked the demo.
d: Pretty well, thanks. It starts at two.
Fine, thanks. And how are you?
Thanks, I'll send you the slides.
ex: How did ___ go? 問結果,用過去式回答並補細節;其他沒說結果。

line: Does anyone have any questions before we move on?
a: Just one — when's the deadline for phase two?
d: Yes, let's move on to the next item.
Just one — I'm moving to Taichung in May.
Sure — I'll answer any questions you have.
ex: Just one 帶出問題;move on 是進下一項,不是搬家,答問題是主持人的事。

line: Could you cover for me at the 2 p.m. call?
a: Sure. Anything I should know beforehand?
d: Sure. I'll cover the table with this cloth.
Sure. Thanks so much for covering for me.
Sure. How was the call this morning?
ex: cover for 是代班;答應並問須知;不是蓋桌布,道謝是請託者的話。

line: Can you have the report ready by Friday?
a: Friday might be tight, but I'll do my best.
d: Friday works. I'll read it over the weekend, then.
Thanks, I really enjoyed reading the report.
Friday's great — I'm going to the beach that day.
ex: tight = 時間很緊,誠實回應並盡力;其他把報告當成要讀的或答週五安排。

line: I'm afraid the salmon is sold out tonight.
a: Oh, that's a shame. What would you recommend instead?
d: Oh, that's a shame. Don't be afraid, it's not your fault.
Oh, that's a shame. I'll have the salmon, then, please.
Oh, that's great. Could we have the check now, please?
ex: I'm afraid 是「恐怕」委婉語,不是害怕;請對方推薦替代。

line: I'm sorry, but check-in isn't until 3 p.m.
a: No problem. Could I leave my luggage here until then?
d: No problem. Could you call me a taxi to the airport, then?
No problem. I'll check out by three o'clock tomorrow, then.
No problem. Could I have a wake-up call at three, please?
ex: 接受規定並詢問寄放行李;其他把入住和退房、叫車、叫醒混為一談。

line: We're having a barbecue on Saturday. Want to come?
a: I'd love to, but I'm visiting my parents. Next time?
d: I'd love to, but I'm visiting my parents. See you there!
Thanks, it was great! The barbecue was really delicious.
I'd love to come. What time does the movie start, exactly?
ex: 婉拒公式:I'd love to, but + 理由 + 提議下次。

line: I'm not sure I follow. Could you explain that again?
a: Sure — basically, we're switching suppliers to cut costs.
d: Sure — basically, I'm following you on social media now.
Sure — could you explain that again a bit more slowly?
Sure — basically, I'm not sure I follow you either.
ex: follow 在此是「聽懂」;用 basically 換句話簡述。

line: Could I have your account number, please?
d: Sure, it's under Chen.
Sure, here you are.
Sure, it's 4:30 p.m.
ex: 直接報出帳號;電話中不能遞東西,報名字或時間也不對題。

line: Your flight has been delayed by two hours.
a: Oh no. Will I still make my connection in Tokyo?
d: Great. So we'll land two hours earlier, right?
Oh no. Could you call me a taxi to the airport, please?
Oh no. Did I leave my passport at the check-in counter?
ex: make my connection = 趕得上轉機,是最實際的追問。

line: Would you like to keep the receipt?
a: Yes, please — just in case.
d: Yes, please — keep the change.
Yes, I'll pay in cash.
Sure, here's my card.
ex: just in case = 以防萬一;找零、付現、給卡都沒回答要不要收據。

line: I think we should postpone the launch.
a: I see your point, but the client is expecting it next week.
d: I see your point, so let's launch it this Friday as we planned.
Thanks for the update. When did the launch go out?
That sounds great. I'll book the launch party, then.
ex: I see your point, but… 是委婉表達不同意的常用句;其他自相矛盾或答錯時態。

line: Sorry to interrupt, but we're running out of time.
a: Right, let's wrap up the last item quickly.
d: Right, let's add a few more items to the agenda, then.
Sure, sorry for interrupting you.
Right, I'll buy more paper after lunch.
ex: wrap up = 收尾;時間不夠不能再加議程,running out 不是用完紙。

line: Great job on the client meeting today.
a: Thanks! The team prepared really well.
d: Thanks! I'll prepare for the client meeting.
You're welcome. It was my pleasure.
Sure, I'll tell the client tomorrow.
ex: 接受稱讚並歸功團隊;You're welcome 回謝謝,會議已經開完。

line: Sorry for the wait. Here's your pasta.
a: Thanks. Could we also get some more bread?
d: Thanks. Could we also order the pasta, please?
No problem. Sorry for the wait. Enjoy your meal.
Thanks. I'll be ready to order in a few minutes.
ex: 大方接受並提出新需求;菜已上不能再點同一道,另一句是服務生台詞。

line: Is everything all right here?
a: Actually, I ordered the chicken, not the beef.
d: Yes, everything's fine. Could we get some more water?
Actually, I'll cook the chicken at home tonight, thanks.
Actually, the restroom is just over there, on the left.
ex: Actually 開頭委婉指出上錯菜;說一切都好就沒解決問題。

line: How long have you had this cough?
a: About a week now.
d: About once a week.
Three times a day.
It's a dry one, I think.
ex: How long 問持續多久;once a week、three times a day 是頻率。

line: Take this twice a day after meals.
a: Got it. Should I avoid alcohol?
d: Got it. What's for dinner?
Sure, take it with water.
Got it. Was it expensive?
ex: Got it 表示了解,再問相關注意事項;其他是藥師的話或不相干。

line: I'm thinking of quitting my job.
a: Really? What happened?
d: Really? When did you start?
Really? Where to?
Really? How much?
ex: 先關心原因;問何時開始、去哪、多少錢都是別的話題。

line: Do you know where the projector remote is?
a: I think Amy had it in the meeting room.
d: I think the meeting room is booked till four.
I think the projector is broken again.
It's on the remote server, I think.
ex: Do you know where 要回答在哪裡;其他沒說遙控器的位置。

line: Would you mind switching seats so I can sit with my son?
a: Not at all. Which seat is yours?
d: Sure, I'll sit with my son.
Not at all. I'll switch it off.
Thank you so much. That's kind.
ex: Would you mind 同意要說 Not at all。

line: Want to grab a coffee after this?
a: I'd love to, but I have another call. Rain check?
d: Thanks for the coffee! That was really nice of you.
Sure, I'll grab the meeting notes after this, too.
No thanks, I'm just looking around today.
ex: rain check = 改天再約,婉拒常用;咖啡還沒喝,其他誤解 grab。

line: Could you send over the updated quote by end of day?
a: Will do — you'll have it by 5 p.m.
d: Thanks — I received it this morning.
Sure — the quote was helpful.
Will do — I'll be in by noon.
ex: Will do 是「好的,會處理」;再給明確時間;其他像收件者或答錯事。

line: Quick question — is the server down for you too?
a: Yeah, same here. IT is on it.
d: Yeah, I'll be down soon.
No, it's upstairs, I think.
Sure, I'll ask him later.
ex: same here = 我也是;down 指當機,不是下樓或在樓上。

line: I've attached the draft. Let me know what you think.
a: Thanks — I'll take a look and get back to you this afternoon.
d: Thanks — I'll attach the draft and send it to you this afternoon.
Thanks — I think it's a great idea to meet this afternoon.
Thanks — what do you think of my draft, by the way?
ex: get back to you = 再回覆你;附草稿、問對方意見是寄件者的角色。

line: Hi, I'm calling about the job ad on your website.
a: Sure, which position are you interested in?
d: Thanks, I'm interested in the engineering position.
Sure, I'll post a new ad on the website tomorrow.
Sure, I'd love to work for your company.

Two hours, if possible.

Yes, I'll send it to you as soon as I get to the office.
Not yet, but I got your package at the front desk.

Hi all, I'm going to the data center.

Oh, sorry. Let me try the card machine for you.
Oh, that's strange. I'll take it, then.

I'm glad you enjoyed it. Who cooked it?

Confirmed — I'll send you the agenda by May 3.

line: Are you coming to Amy's party?

Yes! Happy birthday to you, Amy!
Sure! I'll ask Amy if she's coming.

line: Can you jump on a quick call?
a: Sure, give me two minutes.
d: Sure, I'll email you next week.
Sure, the call went well.
Sure, I'll book a room.

Fair enough. Let's go with the new design, then.
Fair enough. When did you draw it?

Great, I'll check out now.

Sure, I'll take the bus.
Not at all, keep the change.

Almost three hours a day.
Every three years or so.

d: Thanks, but I've already got a ride home tonight.
Sounds fun! How was it? Did you go with Amy?
I'm fine, thanks — I just had a bite of cake.
ex: Fancy…? = 想不想…;rain check = 改天。

line: I'll keep you in the loop.
a: Thanks, I appreciate it.
d: Thanks, I'll keep you posted.
Sorry, I'm out of the loop.
Great, what time does it start?
ex: keep you in the loop = 隨時讓你知道進度。

line: Is there any wiggle room on the price?
a: There might be a little if you can commit to a longer contract.
d: There's plenty of room — the price includes free parking.
Could you lower the price a little if we sign for longer?
Sure, the price is listed on our website under Plans.
ex: wiggle room = 彈性空間(議價)。

line: Well, that went down like a lead balloon.
a: Yeah, tough crowd. Maybe the joke needed more context.
d: Yeah, everyone loved it. Maybe we should do it again next week.
Yeah, tough crowd. Maybe I should order more balloons for the party.
Thanks — I worked really hard on that joke. Glad you liked it.
ex: go down like a lead balloon = 完全冷場、反應很差。

line: We may need to move the goalposts a bit.
a: Understood, but if the targets change, can we revisit the deadline too?
d: Understood. As the targets aren't changing, we'll keep the deadline.
Thanks — I'm glad we're sticking to the original plan.
Understood. When did you move into the new office?
ex: move the goalposts = 中途改變目標或標準。

line: I think the new manager is a bit out of his depth.
a: Maybe, but it's early days. Let's give him a chance.
d: I agree — he's clearly very experienced and knows the job well.
Yes, he started here years ago, so he knows everyone well.
Maybe, but it's early days. When does he officially retire?
ex: out of one's depth = 力不從心;early days = 還早。

line: Let's circle back on this next week.
a: Sounds good. I'll send a calendar invite for Tuesday.
d: Sounds good. I'll draw a circle around the main points for you.
Sounds good. Let's wrap it up today, then — I'll sign now.
Sounds good. Could you send me the calendar invite for last Tuesday?
ex: circle back = 之後再回頭討論。

line: Honestly, this project has been a bit of a poisoned chalice.
a: I can imagine — high visibility, but no budget to match.
d: I can imagine — it's been an easy win with a huge budget, right?
Really? Did someone get sick from the drinks at the party?
I can imagine — everyone's been fighting to join the team.
ex: poisoned chalice = 看似榮耀實則燙手山芋。

line: How's everything tasting?
a: Lovely, thanks. Could we get some more water when you have a chance?
d: Lovely, thanks. Could we see the menu, please? We haven't ordered yet.
It's a table for two, please. Could we sit by the window, if possible?
Everything's been fine at home, thanks. How's your family been lately?
ex: 禮貌回應並順帶提出需求。

line: I'm afraid we've had to upgrade you to a suite.
a: Oh, that's no problem at all — thank you!
d: Oh no, is there anything you can do?
Oh no — could I get a refund, then?
Thanks, I'll wait in the lobby, then.
ex: I'm afraid 有時只是客套開頭,這裡其實是好消息。

line: Sorry about the noise last night.
a: Oh, no worries — I hardly noticed.
d: Oh, thanks — it was a great party, wasn't it?
Sorry, I'll keep it down tonight.
Oh, really? What did you hear?
ex: no worries / I hardly noticed = 大方帶過。

line: We're doing a farewell lunch for Jen on Friday — you in?
a: Count me in. Where are we going?
d: Count me in. When's her first day?
Sure, I'll tell Jen you're coming.
Yes, I'm in the office.
ex: you in? = 你要參加嗎;count me in = 算我一份。

line: With hindsight, we should have flagged the risk earlier.
a: Agreed. Let's add a risk check to the kickoff checklist.
d: Agreed. Luckily, we flagged the risk early, so no harm done.
Agreed. Let's skip the risk check next time to save some time.
Agreed. When will we have the hindsight report ready for review?
ex: with hindsight = 事後看來;提出改進措施。

line: Bear with me while I pull up your account.
a: Sure, take your time.
d: Sure, I'll pull it up.
Sure, I can wait outside.
Thanks, goodbye!
ex: bear with me = 請稍等。

line: What's your take on the new office layout?
a: I like the open space, but it's hard to focus when it gets noisy.
d: I'll take the desk by the window, if nobody else has claimed it yet.
It's on the third floor, next to the kitchen and the meeting rooms.
Thanks — I designed most of it myself, so I'm really glad you like it.
ex: What's your take on…? = 你對…的看法。

line: That's a non-starter for us.
a: Understood. What would you need to see to make it workable?
d: Great! When can we start, then? I'll send the contract over.
Understood. Could you tell me who will be starting the meeting?
Understood. Let's sign the agreement as it is, then.
ex: non-starter = 完全不可行的提案。

line: I've got a lot on my plate right now.
a: No problem — it can wait until next week.
d: No problem — I'll add a few more tasks to it.
Thanks, I'm not hungry right now.
Great — so you can take this on today?
ex: a lot on my plate = 手上事情很多。
